1.text:
For a point of the cross put $X=r e_{K}$ with $K\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$
and $r\sim {\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ independent, $E|r|=1/2$.  Put
$P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$, $1\le i\le d$, and

$$
V_{d}={\rm Vol}_{d}{\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}.
$$

$V_{d}>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation, ${\mathbb P}
\{{\rm perm}\}=d!/d^{d}$, and on the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.  Hence

$$
E V_{d}= \frac1{d!}\Big(E|r|\Big)^{d}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
       =(2d)^{-d},\qquad EV_{1}=1/2,
$$

i.e. $EV_{d}=2^{-d}d^{-d}$.

For $i\ne j$

$$
E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
 =d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}},
$$

$$
E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3,\qquad 
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
 =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
 =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\bigl(1+\sqrt2\bigr)}{3}\approx0.765195716,
$$

so that with $E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|$

$$
E_{d}= \frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d},\qquad E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2 .
$$

For the $N_{d}=d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered pair
distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{\,\dfrac{5d-2}{3}+(d-1)^{2}I\,}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I .
$$

Hence on the i.i.d. cross the origin–augmented ratio is

$$
R_{d}=\frac{EV_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
            {d^{\,d-1}\Bigl[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\Bigr]},\qquad
R_{1}=1,
$$

and

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d & R_{d}\\ \hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.10927\\
3&0.00751\\
4&0.000379\\
5&1.5\times10^{-5}
\end{array}
$$

$R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$ is summable.  With
$I=(\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2))/3$,

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
   =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots\approx1.1172,
$$

i.e. $S_{\infty}\simeq1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ being the
whole unit and the $d=2$ term $0.1093$ essentially the whole remainder.
In particular $\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$.
This is the $EV_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ value for the i.i.d. cross
$\cup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}$ with the origin added.  Up to the
usual distinct–axis normalisation $EV_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$, $\bar D_{d}^{0}
=[1+(d-1)I]/(d+1)$, one obtains $R_{d}^{0}=(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}$
and $\sum_{d}R_{d}^{0}\approx1.250$, and with the inter–point
normalisation $E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|$ alone
$\sum_{d}(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}\approx0.844$, the familiar $e^{1/2}-1$ form.

2.text:
For the i.i.d. cross

$X_{i}=T_{i}e_{K_{i}},\;K_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\},\;
T_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}(-1,1)$

put $S_{d}=\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$.  With $E|T|=1/2$

$E\|X_{i}\|=1/2,\qquad 
E|T_{1}-T_{2}|=2/3$,

\[
I:=E\sqrt{T_{1}^{2}+T_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\bigl(1+\sqrt2\bigr)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots
\]

Hence for $i\ne j$

\[
E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
     =\frac1dE|T_{1}-T_{2}|+\frac{d-1}{d}I
     =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d}\;,
\]

and, on the event $\{K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}\}$ a permutation,
$P({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and $|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|T_{i}|$,
so that

\[
E{\rm Vol}_{d}\bigl({\rm conv}S_{d}\bigr)
   =\frac1{d!}P({\rm perm})(E|T|)^{d}
   =\Bigl(\frac1{2d}\Bigr)^{d},\qquad 
E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2 .
\]

For the $d+1$ points the mean unordered pair distance is

\[
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{dE\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I,
\]
$\bar D_{1}=1/2$, and

\[
R_{d}:=\frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]},
\qquad R_{1}=1 .
\]

In particular

* $R_{1}=1.000000$ ,
* $R_{2}=(2\cdot2)^{-2}/{\bar D_{2}}=0.0625/0.571977\approx0.10927$ ,
* $R_{3}=(2\cdot3)^{-3}/{\bar D_{3}}=0.0046296/0.616176\approx0.00751$ ,
* $R_{4}\approx3.8\times10^{-4}$ , $R_{5}\approx1.5\times10^{-5}$ ,

and $R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$.  Hence

\[
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
   =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+0.00002+\cdots
   \approx1.1172,
\]

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ being the
dominant term and the whole $d\ge2$ contribution being
$\approx0.117$.  With the usual $d=1$ normalisation this is the
origin-augmented i.i.d. cross sum; the $d\ge2$ tail is already
$0.1093+0.0075+\dots\approx0.117$.  The familiar $X_{i}-X_{j}$
only normalisation $R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ gives the
$0.844$ value quoted for the inter-point version. ∎

8.text:
With the i.i.d. cross model write $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$, $r_{i}\sim
U[-1,1]$, $K_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$ and $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$,
$1\le i\le d$.  Put

$$E|r|=\frac12,\qquad E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=\frac23,\qquad
c:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
      =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
      =\frac{\sqrt2+\log \!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots ,
$$
$\delta=c-2/3$.  For two i.i.d. cross points

$$E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
       =\frac1dE|r_{1}-r_{2}|+\frac{d-1}{d}c
       =c-\frac{\delta}{d},\qquad \delta\approx0.098529,$$

and $E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2$.  The $d$-volume is non–zero iff
$(K_{1},\dots ,K_{d})$ is a permutation, ${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$,
and on the permutation event $|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.
Hence

$$E{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})=\frac1{d!}\Big(\frac12\Big)^{d}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
        =(2d)^{-d},\qquad E{\rm Vol}_{1}=\frac12 ,$$
$H_{d}={\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$.
The mean unordered pair distance of the $d+1$ points
$\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$ is

$$\bar D_{d}
   =\frac{d\,\tfrac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
   =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
   =\frac{1+(d-1)c-(d-1)\delta/d}{d+1},
\qquad\bar D_{1}=1/2,
$$
$\bar D_{d}\to c$.  With the origin–augmented normalisation

$$R_{d}:=\frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
      =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
      =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}
             {\,1+(d-1)\!\left[c-\delta/d\right]},\qquad R_{1}=1,$$
is the $d$-th term.  Numerically

* $R_{1}=1.000000$,
* $R_{2}=(4)^{-2}\! \times3/\!\bigl[1+E_{2}\bigr]\approx0.10927$,
* $R_{3}=(6)^{-3}\! \times4/\!\bigl[1+2E_{3}\bigr]\approx0.00751$,
* $R_{4}\approx3.79\times10^{-4}$,
* $R_{5}\approx1.51\times10^{-5}$,
* $R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$,

so that

$$S_{N}=\sum_{d=1}^{N}R_{d}
     =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
     \xrightarrow[N\to\infty]{}S_{\infty}\approx1.1172,$$
i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ being the unit
contribution and the whole non–trivial remainder $\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}
\approx0.117$ being dominated by the $d=2$ term $0.109$.

In particular $R_{1}=1$, $R_{2}\simeq0.109$, $R_{3}\simeq7.5\times10^{-3}$
and the series is essentially exhausted after $d=3$.  This is the
origin–inclusive $E{\rm Vol}_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ sum.  On the usual
inter–point normalisation $E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=E_{d}$ the $d$-ratio is
$R_{d}^{0}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$, $R_{1}^{0}=3/4$, $R_{2}^{0}\approx0.0873$,
etc., and $\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{0}\approx0.844$, the familiar $0.84$ form.
The $R_{d}^{\ast}=2^{-d}/d!$ one-point-per-axis normalisation gives
$\sum_{d}R_{d}^{\ast}\approx1.25$, i.e. $(e^{1/2}-1)/c\approx0.848$ in the
un-averaged inter–point form. ∎

7.text:
For the cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{r e_{k}:|r|<1\}$

write $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$ with $K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$,
$r_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ i.i.d.  Put $P_{0}=0$ and $P_{i}=X_{i}$,
$1\le i\le d$, and $H_{d}={\rm conv}\{P_{0},P_{1},\dots ,P_{d}\}$.
On $\{K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}\}$ a permutation

$|\det [X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i=1}^{d}|r_{i}|$,
${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})=d!^{-1}|\det [X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|$,
${\mathbb P}\{K\;{\rm perm}\}=d!/d^{\,d}$ and $E|r|=1/2$, whence

$${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})
   =\frac1{d!}\Big(\frac12\Big)^{d}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
   =(2d)^{-d},\qquad {\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{1}= \tfrac12 ,$$
and ${\rm Vol}_{d}=0$ on the collision event.

For two i.i.d. cross points

$\|X-Y\|=
\begin{cases}
|r_{X}-r_{Y}|,&K_{X}=K_{Y}\\[1mm]
\sqrt{r_{X}^{2}+r_{Y}^{2}},&K_{X}\ne K_{Y}
\end{cases}$

and with $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$

$$
E_{d}:=E\|X-Y\|
      =d^{-1}\frac23+\Bigl(1-d^{-1}\Bigr)I,
\qquad 
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du\,dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
   \approx0.7651957 .
$$

Hence $E_{d}=I+(2/3-I)/d$ and $E\|X_{i}\|=1/2$.  With $N_{d}=d+1$
unordered pairs the mean pair distance of the $d+1$ point set
$\{0,X_{i}\}$ is

$$
\bar D_{d}
   =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
    =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
    =\frac{5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}}{3d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I .
$$

In particular $\bar D_{1}=1/2$.  The mean-volume-over-mean-pair
ratio is therefore

$$
R_{d}:=\frac{{\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)(2d)^{-d}}{\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}},\qquad R_{1}=1,
$$

and $R_{d}=O\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$.  Numerically

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d & R_{d}\\ \hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.109270\\
3&0.007513\\
4&0.000379\\
5&1.51\times10^{-5}\\
\vdots &\vdots
\end{array}
$$

so that the series is essentially the $d=1,2$ terms.  With
$I=(\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2))/3$,

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
 =1+\frac1{16\bar D_{2}}+\frac1{216\bar D_{3}}+\cdots
 \approx1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
 \approx1.1172,
$$

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ being the unit
$d=1$ contribution and $R_{2}\approx0.109$ the dominant remainder.
In the point–point normalisation $R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ this
is $\sum_{d}R_{d}^{\star}\approx0.844$, the familiar $3/4+0.0873+\dots$
form.  The $1$ point-per-axis convention ${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}
=2^{-d}/d!$ gives the often quoted $\sum_{d}(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}
\approx1.2497\approx1.25$ and the unaveraged form
$\sum_{d}2^{-d}/(d!I)=(e^{1/2}-1)/I\approx0.848$. ∎

5.text:
In the cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}$,

write $X=r e_{K}$ with $K\sim{\rm Unif}\{1\ldots d\}$,
$r\sim{\rm Unif}(-1,1)$ independent and put $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$,
$i=1\ldots d$, i.i.d., $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$.
Put

$$
V_{d}={\rm Vol}_{d}\!\left({\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\ldots ,X_{d}\}\right) .
$$

${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})>0$ iff $K_{1},\ldots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation.
On that event $|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$ and

$$
{\mathbb E}V_{d}
 =\frac1{d!}{\mathbb P}\!\left\{K\;{\rm perm}\right\}\!
   \Bigl({\mathbb E}|r|\Bigr)^{d}
 =\frac1{d!}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}\Bigl(\frac12\Bigr)^{d}
 =(2d)^{-d},
\qquad {\mathbb E}V_{1}=1/2 .
$$

For two i.i.d. cross points

$$
{\mathbb E}\|X-Y\|
 =d^{-1}{\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|
  +(1-d^{-1}){\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}},
$$

${\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$$
c:={\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
 =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
 =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
 \approx0.765195716 .
$$

Hence with $\delta=c-2/3$

$$
E_{d}:={\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
     =c-\frac{\delta}{d},\qquad\delta\approx0.09852905,
$$

and for the $N_{d}=d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered
pair distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\,{\mathbb E}\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1},\qquad {\mathbb E}\|X\|=1/2,
$$

$\bar D_{d}\to c$.  The mean-volume-over-mean-pair-distance ratio is

$$
R_{d}^{\rm iid}
 =\frac{{\mathbb E}V_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
 =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}{1+(d-1)E_{d}},\qquad R_{1}=1,
$$

i.e. in closed form

$$
R_{d}^{\rm iid}
 =\frac{(d+1)(2d)^{-d}}
       {\,1+(d-1)\!\left[c-\delta/d\right]},\qquad 
c=\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}{3}.
$$

Numerically

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d & R_{d}^{\rm iid}\\ \hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.10927\\
3&0.00751\\
4&3.79\times10^{-4}\\
5&1.51\times10^{-5}\\
\vdots &\vdots
\end{array}
$$

so that $R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$ and

$$
S^{\rm iid}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{\rm iid}
 =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots\approx1.117\;,
$$

$1.1172\ldots$ in the usual average-over-all-unordered-pairs
normalisation.  The $d=1$ term is $1$ and the whole remainder is
$ \approx0.1172$, essentially the $d=2$ contribution $0.1093$.

*Remark.*  On the pure ensemble pair normalisation
$R_{d}^{\star}={\mathbb E}V_{d}/E_{d}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ one gets
$R_{1}^{\star}=3/4$ and

$$
\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{\star}
 =\frac34+\frac{1/16}{c-\delta/2}
  +\frac{1/216}{c-\delta/3}+\cdots\approx0.844,
$$

i.e. $\approx0.843\!-\!0.844$ for the $X_{i}\!-\!X_{j}$ distance, the
$0.8478$ $e^{1/2}-1$ value being the distinct-axis, one-point-per-axis
normalisation $ {\mathbb E}V_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$. ∎

4.text:
For a cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}$ put
$X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$, $K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$,
$r_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ i.i.d.  Let $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$,
$1\le i\le d$, and $H_{d}={\rm conv}\{P_{0},P_{1},\dots ,P_{d}\}$.
On the injective event $\{K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}\}$ is a permutation, 
${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$, and on that event

$|\det M_{d}|=\prod_{i=1}^{d}|r_{i}|$, $\qquad 
{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})=d!^{-1}|\det M_{d}|$,

so that with ${\mathbb E}|r|=1/2$

${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})
   =d!^{-1}\bigl({\mathbb E}|r|\bigr)^{d}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})
   =(2d)^{-d}$, $\qquad {\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2$,

and ${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})=0$ otherwise.  For two i.i.d. cross
points

${\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
   =d^{-1}{\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|
    +(1-d^{-1}){\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}$

with ${\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$I:={\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
   \approx0.7651957$,

i.e. ${\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=E_{d}=[2/3+(d-1)I]/d$.
With $N_{d}=d+1$ points the mean unordered pair distance is

$\bar D_{d}
   =\frac{d{\mathbb E}\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
   =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
   =\frac{(5d-2)/3+I(d-1)^{2}}{d(d+1)},\qquad 
   \bar D_{1}=1/2,$

$\bar D_{d}\to I$.  Hence

$r_{d}:=\frac{{\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})}{\bar D_{d}}
     =\frac{d(d+1)(2d)^{-d}}{(5d-2)/3+I(d-1)^{2}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\!\left[5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]}$,
$r_{1}=1$,

and

$r_{2}=\frac{9/4}{2\,(8+3I)}\approx0.10927$,
$r_{3}\approx7.51\times10^{-3}$,
$r_{4}\approx3.79\times10^{-4}$,
$r_{5}\approx1.51\times10^{-5}$,
$r_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$.

In particular

$\sum_{d\ge1}r_{d}
 =1+r_{2}+r_{3}+\cdots
 =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.000379+0.000015+\cdots$

$ \approx1.1172\approx1.12$,

the $d=1$ term being the unit contribution and the whole
remainder being $0.117\ldots$, essentially the $d=2$ term $0.109$.
Up to the $1/(d+1)$ averaging this is the usual
${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}/{\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|$ ratio
$(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ whose sum is $\approx0.844$; on the conventional
one-point-per-axis normalisation $ {\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}=2^{-d}/d!$
and ${\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=I$ one obtains
$R_{d}^{0}=(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d!\,[1+(d-1)I]\}$ with
$\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{0}=1.2497\!\approx\!1.250$, i.e.
$\sum_{d\ge1}2^{-d}/d!I=(e^{1/2}-1)/I\approx0.848$ in the pure
inter-point normalisation.  This is the $1.117\approx1.12$ i.i.d.
cross value quoted above, $R_{1}=1$, $R_{2}\simeq0.109$, etc. ∎

6.text:
With the $d$-cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{r e_{k}:|r|<1\}$

put $X=r e_{K}$, $K\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$, $r\sim {\rm Unif}[-1,1]$
and $X_{i}$, $1\le i\le d$, i.i.d.  For

$H_{d}={\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$

$|\det [X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation
and on this event $|\det [X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.  With
${\mathbf E}|r|=1/2$

${\mathbf E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})
 =\frac1{d!}{\mathbf E}\Big[\prod_{i}|r_{i}|\,
 {\bf1}_{\{K\,{\rm perm}\}}\Big]
 =\frac{(1/2)^{d}}{d!}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
 =(2d)^{-d},\qquad {\mathbf E}{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2,
$

and, up to the permutation, $V_{d}>0$ only on the $d!/d^{d}$ event.
For two i.i.d. cross points

${\mathbf E}\|X-Y\|=
d^{-1}{\mathbf E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})
{\mathbf E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}$

${\mathbf E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$,

$c:={\mathbf E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du\,dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}{3}=0.7651957\ldots$

so that with $\delta=c-2/3$

$E_{d}:={\mathbf E}\|X-Y\|=c-\delta/d$, $\qquad 
\delta\approx0.098529$.

For the $N_{d}=d+1$ point set $\{0,X_{i}\}$,
${\mathbf E}\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2$ and the mean unordered pair distance is

$\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{5d-2+3c(d-1)^{2}}{3d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}c .
$

Hence on the origin-augmented i.i.d. cross

$r_{d}:=\frac{{\mathbf E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})}{\bar D_{d}}
      =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
      =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3c(d-1)^{2}\right]}$,

$r_{1}=1$,

$r_{2}= \dfrac{1/16}{\,[1+E_{2}]/3}=0.10927\ldots$,
$r_{3}=0.007513\ldots$, $r_{4}=3.79\times10^{-4}\ldots$,
$r_{5}=1.5\times10^{-5}\ldots$,

$r_{d}=O\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$.  The series is therefore essentially
$r_{1}+r_{2}$,

$S_{N}=\sum_{d=1}^{N}r_{d}=1+0.109270+0.007513+0.000379+0.000015+\cdots$,

$S_{\infty}=1.117\!-\!1.118$,

$S_{\infty}\approx1.1172$,

i.e. $1.117$ to three decimals, $r_{1}=1$ being the $d=1$ term and
$r_{2}\approx0.109$ the first non-trivial correction.  In particular
$\sum_{d\ge2}r_{d}\approx0.117$ and the tail beyond $d=3$ is
$<5\times10^{-4}$.

Remark.  On the usual sample–sample normalisation
$R_{d}^{ss}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ one has $R_{1}^{ss}=3/4$ and
$\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{ss}\approx0.844$, the $0.844$ quoted in the
literature; with the one-point-per-axis convention
${\mathbf E}{\rm Vol}_{d}=2^{-d}/d!$ the origin-augmented sum is
$\sum_{d}(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)c]\}\approx1.250$, i.e.
$(e^{1/2}-1)/c\approx0.848$ on the pure inter-point normalisation. ∎

public_text.1:
For a point of the cross put $X=r e_{K}$ with $K\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$
and $r\sim {\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ independent, $E|r|=1/2$.  Put
$P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$, $1\le i\le d$, and

$$
V_{d}={\rm Vol}_{d}{\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}.
$$

$V_{d}>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation, ${\mathbb P}
\{{\rm perm}\}=d!/d^{d}$, and on the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.  Hence

$$
E V_{d}= \frac1{d!}\Big(E|r|\Big)^{d}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
       =(2d)^{-d},\qquad EV_{1}=1/2,
$$

i.e. $EV_{d}=2^{-d}d^{-d}$.

For $i\ne j$

$$
E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
 =d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}},
$$

$$
E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3,\qquad 
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
 =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
 =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\bigl(1+\sqrt2\bigr)}{3}\approx0.765195716,
$$

so that with $E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|$

$$
E_{d}= \frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d},\qquad E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2 .
$$

For the $N_{d}=d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered pair
distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{\,\dfrac{5d-2}{3}+(d-1)^{2}I\,}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I .
$$

Hence on the i.i.d. cross the origin–augmented ratio is

$$
R_{d}=\frac{EV_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
            {d^{\,d-1}\Bigl[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\Bigr]},\qquad
R_{1}=1,
$$

and

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d & R_{d}\\ \hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.10927\\
3&0.00751\\
4&0.000379\\
5&1.5\times10^{-5}
\end{array}
$$

$R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$ is summable.  With
$I=(\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2))/3$,

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
   =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots\approx1.1172,
$$

i.e. $S_{\infty}\simeq1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ being the
whole unit and the $d=2$ term $0.1093$ essentially the whole remainder.
In particular $\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$.
This is the $EV_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ value for the i.i.d. cross
$\cup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}$ with the origin added.  Up to the
usual distinct–axis normalisation $EV_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$, $\bar D_{d}^{0}
=[1+(d-1)I]/(d+1)$, one obtains $R_{d}^{0}=(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}$
and $\sum_{d}R_{d}^{0}\approx1.250$, and with the inter–point
normalisation $E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|$ alone
$\sum_{d}(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}\approx0.844$, the familiar $e^{1/2}-1$ form.
public_text.2:
For the i.i.d. cross

$X_{i}=T_{i}e_{K_{i}},\;K_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\},\;
T_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}(-1,1)$

put $S_{d}=\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$.  With $E|T|=1/2$

$E\|X_{i}\|=1/2,\qquad 
E|T_{1}-T_{2}|=2/3$,

\[
I:=E\sqrt{T_{1}^{2}+T_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\bigl(1+\sqrt2\bigr)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots
\]

Hence for $i\ne j$

\[
E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
     =\frac1dE|T_{1}-T_{2}|+\frac{d-1}{d}I
     =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d}\;,
\]

and, on the event $\{K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}\}$ a permutation,
$P({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and $|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|T_{i}|$,
so that

\[
E{\rm Vol}_{d}\bigl({\rm conv}S_{d}\bigr)
   =\frac1{d!}P({\rm perm})(E|T|)^{d}
   =\Bigl(\frac1{2d}\Bigr)^{d},\qquad 
E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2 .
\]

For the $d+1$ points the mean unordered pair distance is

\[
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{dE\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I,
\]
$\bar D_{1}=1/2$, and

\[
R_{d}:=\frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]},
\qquad R_{1}=1 .
\]

In particular

* $R_{1}=1.000000$ ,
* $R_{2}=(2\cdot2)^{-2}/{\bar D_{2}}=0.0625/0.571977\approx0.10927$ ,
* $R_{3}=(2\cdot3)^{-3}/{\bar D_{3}}=0.0046296/0.616176\approx0.00751$ ,
* $R_{4}\approx3.8\times10^{-4}$ , $R_{5}\approx1.5\times10^{-5}$ ,

and $R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$.  Hence

\[
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
   =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+0.00002+\cdots
   \approx1.1172,
\]

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ being the
dominant term and the whole $d\ge2$ contribution being
$\approx0.117$.  With the usual $d=1$ normalisation this is the
origin-augmented i.i.d. cross sum; the $d\ge2$ tail is already
$0.1093+0.0075+\dots\approx0.117$.  The familiar $X_{i}-X_{j}$
only normalisation $R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ gives the
$0.844$ value quoted for the inter-point version. ∎
public_text.8:
With the i.i.d. cross model write $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$, $r_{i}\sim
U[-1,1]$, $K_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$ and $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$,
$1\le i\le d$.  Put

$$E|r|=\frac12,\qquad E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=\frac23,\qquad
c:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
      =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
      =\frac{\sqrt2+\log \!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots ,
$$
$\delta=c-2/3$.  For two i.i.d. cross points

$$E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
       =\frac1dE|r_{1}-r_{2}|+\frac{d-1}{d}c
       =c-\frac{\delta}{d},\qquad \delta\approx0.098529,$$

and $E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2$.  The $d$-volume is non–zero iff
$(K_{1},\dots ,K_{d})$ is a permutation, ${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$,
and on the permutation event $|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.
Hence

$$E{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})=\frac1{d!}\Big(\frac12\Big)^{d}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
        =(2d)^{-d},\qquad E{\rm Vol}_{1}=\frac12 ,$$
$H_{d}={\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$.
The mean unordered pair distance of the $d+1$ points
$\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$ is

$$\bar D_{d}
   =\frac{d\,\tfrac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
   =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
   =\frac{1+(d-1)c-(d-1)\delta/d}{d+1},
\qquad\bar D_{1}=1/2,
$$
$\bar D_{d}\to c$.  With the origin–augmented normalisation

$$R_{d}:=\frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
      =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
      =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}
             {\,1+(d-1)\!\left[c-\delta/d\right]},\qquad R_{1}=1,$$
is the $d$-th term.  Numerically

* $R_{1}=1.000000$,
* $R_{2}=(4)^{-2}\! \times3/\!\bigl[1+E_{2}\bigr]\approx0.10927$,
* $R_{3}=(6)^{-3}\! \times4/\!\bigl[1+2E_{3}\bigr]\approx0.00751$,
* $R_{4}\approx3.79\times10^{-4}$,
* $R_{5}\approx1.51\times10^{-5}$,
* $R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$,

so that

$$S_{N}=\sum_{d=1}^{N}R_{d}
     =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
     \xrightarrow[N\to\infty]{}S_{\infty}\approx1.1172,$$
i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ being the unit
contribution and the whole non–trivial remainder $\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}
\approx0.117$ being dominated by the $d=2$ term $0.109$.

In particular $R_{1}=1$, $R_{2}\simeq0.109$, $R_{3}\simeq7.5\times10^{-3}$
and the series is essentially exhausted after $d=3$.  This is the
origin–inclusive $E{\rm Vol}_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ sum.  On the usual
inter–point normalisation $E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=E_{d}$ the $d$-ratio is
$R_{d}^{0}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$, $R_{1}^{0}=3/4$, $R_{2}^{0}\approx0.0873$,
etc., and $\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{0}\approx0.844$, the familiar $0.84$ form.
The $R_{d}^{\ast}=2^{-d}/d!$ one-point-per-axis normalisation gives
$\sum_{d}R_{d}^{\ast}\approx1.25$, i.e. $(e^{1/2}-1)/c\approx0.848$ in the
un-averaged inter–point form. ∎
public_text.7:
For the cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{r e_{k}:|r|<1\}$

write $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$ with $K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$,
$r_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ i.i.d.  Put $P_{0}=0$ and $P_{i}=X_{i}$,
$1\le i\le d$, and $H_{d}={\rm conv}\{P_{0},P_{1},\dots ,P_{d}\}$.
On $\{K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}\}$ a permutation

$|\det [X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i=1}^{d}|r_{i}|$,
${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})=d!^{-1}|\det [X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|$,
${\mathbb P}\{K\;{\rm perm}\}=d!/d^{\,d}$ and $E|r|=1/2$, whence

$${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})
   =\frac1{d!}\Big(\frac12\Big)^{d}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
   =(2d)^{-d},\qquad {\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{1}= \tfrac12 ,$$
and ${\rm Vol}_{d}=0$ on the collision event.

For two i.i.d. cross points

$\|X-Y\|=
\begin{cases}
|r_{X}-r_{Y}|,&K_{X}=K_{Y}\\[1mm]
\sqrt{r_{X}^{2}+r_{Y}^{2}},&K_{X}\ne K_{Y}
\end{cases}$

and with $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$

$$
E_{d}:=E\|X-Y\|
      =d^{-1}\frac23+\Bigl(1-d^{-1}\Bigr)I,
\qquad 
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du\,dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
   \approx0.7651957 .
$$

Hence $E_{d}=I+(2/3-I)/d$ and $E\|X_{i}\|=1/2$.  With $N_{d}=d+1$
unordered pairs the mean pair distance of the $d+1$ point set
$\{0,X_{i}\}$ is

$$
\bar D_{d}
   =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
    =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
    =\frac{5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}}{3d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I .
$$

In particular $\bar D_{1}=1/2$.  The mean-volume-over-mean-pair
ratio is therefore

$$
R_{d}:=\frac{{\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)(2d)^{-d}}{\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}},\qquad R_{1}=1,
$$

and $R_{d}=O\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$.  Numerically

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d & R_{d}\\ \hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.109270\\
3&0.007513\\
4&0.000379\\
5&1.51\times10^{-5}\\
\vdots &\vdots
\end{array}
$$

so that the series is essentially the $d=1,2$ terms.  With
$I=(\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2))/3$,

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
 =1+\frac1{16\bar D_{2}}+\frac1{216\bar D_{3}}+\cdots
 \approx1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
 \approx1.1172,
$$

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ being the unit
$d=1$ contribution and $R_{2}\approx0.109$ the dominant remainder.
In the point–point normalisation $R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ this
is $\sum_{d}R_{d}^{\star}\approx0.844$, the familiar $3/4+0.0873+\dots$
form.  The $1$ point-per-axis convention ${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}
=2^{-d}/d!$ gives the often quoted $\sum_{d}(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}
\approx1.2497\approx1.25$ and the unaveraged form
$\sum_{d}2^{-d}/(d!I)=(e^{1/2}-1)/I\approx0.848$. ∎
public_text.5:
In the cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}$,

write $X=r e_{K}$ with $K\sim{\rm Unif}\{1\ldots d\}$,
$r\sim{\rm Unif}(-1,1)$ independent and put $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$,
$i=1\ldots d$, i.i.d., $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$.
Put

$$
V_{d}={\rm Vol}_{d}\!\left({\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\ldots ,X_{d}\}\right) .
$$

${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})>0$ iff $K_{1},\ldots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation.
On that event $|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$ and

$$
{\mathbb E}V_{d}
 =\frac1{d!}{\mathbb P}\!\left\{K\;{\rm perm}\right\}\!
   \Bigl({\mathbb E}|r|\Bigr)^{d}
 =\frac1{d!}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}\Bigl(\frac12\Bigr)^{d}
 =(2d)^{-d},
\qquad {\mathbb E}V_{1}=1/2 .
$$

For two i.i.d. cross points

$$
{\mathbb E}\|X-Y\|
 =d^{-1}{\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|
  +(1-d^{-1}){\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}},
$$

${\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$$
c:={\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
 =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
 =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
 \approx0.765195716 .
$$

Hence with $\delta=c-2/3$

$$
E_{d}:={\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
     =c-\frac{\delta}{d},\qquad\delta\approx0.09852905,
$$

and for the $N_{d}=d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered
pair distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\,{\mathbb E}\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1},\qquad {\mathbb E}\|X\|=1/2,
$$

$\bar D_{d}\to c$.  The mean-volume-over-mean-pair-distance ratio is

$$
R_{d}^{\rm iid}
 =\frac{{\mathbb E}V_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
 =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}{1+(d-1)E_{d}},\qquad R_{1}=1,
$$

i.e. in closed form

$$
R_{d}^{\rm iid}
 =\frac{(d+1)(2d)^{-d}}
       {\,1+(d-1)\!\left[c-\delta/d\right]},\qquad 
c=\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}{3}.
$$

Numerically

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d & R_{d}^{\rm iid}\\ \hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.10927\\
3&0.00751\\
4&3.79\times10^{-4}\\
5&1.51\times10^{-5}\\
\vdots &\vdots
\end{array}
$$

so that $R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$ and

$$
S^{\rm iid}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{\rm iid}
 =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots\approx1.117\;,
$$

$1.1172\ldots$ in the usual average-over-all-unordered-pairs
normalisation.  The $d=1$ term is $1$ and the whole remainder is
$ \approx0.1172$, essentially the $d=2$ contribution $0.1093$.

*Remark.*  On the pure ensemble pair normalisation
$R_{d}^{\star}={\mathbb E}V_{d}/E_{d}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ one gets
$R_{1}^{\star}=3/4$ and

$$
\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{\star}
 =\frac34+\frac{1/16}{c-\delta/2}
  +\frac{1/216}{c-\delta/3}+\cdots\approx0.844,
$$

i.e. $\approx0.843\!-\!0.844$ for the $X_{i}\!-\!X_{j}$ distance, the
$0.8478$ $e^{1/2}-1$ value being the distinct-axis, one-point-per-axis
normalisation $ {\mathbb E}V_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$. ∎
public_text.4:
For a cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}$ put
$X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$, $K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$,

$1\le i\le d$, and $H_{d}={\rm conv}\{P_{0},P_{1},\dots ,P_{d}\}$.
On the injective event $\{K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}\}$ is a permutation, 
${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$, and on that event

$|\det M_{d}|=\prod_{i=1}^{d}|r_{i}|$, $\qquad 
{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})=d!^{-1}|\det M_{d}|$,

so that with ${\mathbb E}|r|=1/2$

${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})
   =d!^{-1}\bigl({\mathbb E}|r|\bigr)^{d}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})
   =(2d)^{-d}$, $\qquad {\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2$,

and ${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})=0$ otherwise.  For two i.i.d. cross
points

${\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
   =d^{-1}{\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|
    +(1-d^{-1}){\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}$

with ${\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$I:={\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
   \approx0.7651957$,

i.e. ${\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=E_{d}=[2/3+(d-1)I]/d$.
With $N_{d}=d+1$ points the mean unordered pair distance is

$\bar D_{d}
   =\frac{d{\mathbb E}\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
   =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
   =\frac{(5d-2)/3+I(d-1)^{2}}{d(d+1)},\qquad 
   \bar D_{1}=1/2,$

$\bar D_{d}\to I$.  Hence

$r_{d}:=\frac{{\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})}{\bar D_{d}}
     =\frac{d(d+1)(2d)^{-d}}{(5d-2)/3+I(d-1)^{2}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\!\left[5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]}$,
$r_{1}=1$,

and

$r_{2}=\frac{9/4}{2\,(8+3I)}\approx0.10927$,
$r_{3}\approx7.51\times10^{-3}$,
$r_{4}\approx3.79\times10^{-4}$,
$r_{5}\approx1.51\times10^{-5}$,
$r_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$.

$\sum_{d\ge1}r_{d}
 =1+r_{2}+r_{3}+\cdots
 =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.000379+0.000015+\cdots$

$ \approx1.1172\approx1.12$,

the $d=1$ term being the unit contribution and the whole

$\sum_{d\ge1}2^{-d}/d!I=(e^{1/2}-1)/I\approx0.848$ in the pure

public_text.6:
With the $d$-cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{r e_{k}:|r|<1\}$

put $X=r e_{K}$, $K\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$, $r\sim {\rm Unif}[-1,1]$
and $X_{i}$, $1\le i\le d$, i.i.d.  For

$H_{d}={\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$

$|\det [X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation
and on this event $|\det [X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.  With
${\mathbf E}|r|=1/2$

${\mathbf E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})
 =\frac1{d!}{\mathbf E}\Big[\prod_{i}|r_{i}|\,
 {\bf1}_{\{K\,{\rm perm}\}}\Big]
 =\frac{(1/2)^{d}}{d!}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
 =(2d)^{-d},\qquad {\mathbf E}{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2,
$

and, up to the permutation, $V_{d}>0$ only on the $d!/d^{d}$ event.
For two i.i.d. cross points

${\mathbf E}\|X-Y\|=
d^{-1}{\mathbf E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})
{\mathbf E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}$

${\mathbf E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$,

$c:={\mathbf E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du\,dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}{3}=0.7651957\ldots$

so that with $\delta=c-2/3$

$E_{d}:={\mathbf E}\|X-Y\|=c-\delta/d$, $\qquad 
\delta\approx0.098529$.

For the $N_{d}=d+1$ point set $\{0,X_{i}\}$,
${\mathbf E}\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2$ and the mean unordered pair distance is

$\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{5d-2+3c(d-1)^{2}}{3d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}c .
$

Hence on the origin-augmented i.i.d. cross

$r_{d}:=\frac{{\mathbf E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})}{\bar D_{d}}
      =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
      =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3c(d-1)^{2}\right]}$,

$r_{1}=1$,

$r_{2}= \dfrac{1/16}{\,[1+E_{2}]/3}=0.10927\ldots$,
$r_{3}=0.007513\ldots$, $r_{4}=3.79\times10^{-4}\ldots$,
$r_{5}=1.5\times10^{-5}\ldots$,

$r_{d}=O\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$.  The series is therefore essentially
$r_{1}+r_{2}$,

$S_{N}=\sum_{d=1}^{N}r_{d}=1+0.109270+0.007513+0.000379+0.000015+\cdots$,

$S_{\infty}=1.117\!-\!1.118$,

$S_{\infty}\approx1.1172$,

i.e. $1.117$ to three decimals, $r_{1}=1$ being the $d=1$ term and
$r_{2}\approx0.109$ the first non-trivial correction.  In particular
$\sum_{d\ge2}r_{d}\approx0.117$ and the tail beyond $d=3$ is
$<5\times10^{-4}$.

$R_{d}^{ss}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ one has $R_{1}^{ss}=3/4$ and
$\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}^{ss}\approx0.844$, the $0.844$ quoted in the
literature; with the one-point-per-axis convention
${\mathbf E}{\rm Vol}_{d}=2^{-d}/d!$ the origin-augmented sum is
$\sum_{d}(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)c]\}\approx1.250$, i.e.
$(e^{1/2}-1)/c\approx0.848$ on the pure inter-point normalisation. ∎

2.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The i.i.d. cross model is $X_i=T_i e_{K_i}$, $K_i\sim{\rm Unif}\{1..d\}$, $T_i\sim{\rm Unif}(-1,1)$ i.i.d., $S_d=\{0,X_1..X_d\}$. 
$E|T|=1/2$, $E|T_1-T_2|=2/3$, $I=E\sqrt{T_1^2+T_2^2}=\int_0^1\!\int_0^1\sqrt{u^2+v^2}du dv=(\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2))/3\approx0.765195716$.
$E\|X_i-X_j\|=d^{-1}E|T_1-T_2|+(1-d^{-1})I=[2/3+(d-1)I]/d=:E_d$, $E\|X_i\|=1/2$.
${\rm Vol}_d>0$ iff $K_1..K_d$ is a permutation, $P({\rm perm})=d!/d^d$, and on the event $|\det[X_1..X_d]|=\prod_i|T_i|$. Hence $E{\rm Vol}_d=d!^{-1}P({\rm perm})(E|T|)^d=(2d)^{-d}$, $E{\rm Vol}_1=1/2$.
For the $d+1$ points the mean unordered pair distance is
$\bar D_d=[dE\|X\|+\binom d2E_d]/\binom{d+1}2=[1+(d-1)E_d]/(d+1)=[(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^2I]/[d(d+1)]$, $\bar D_1=1/2$, $\bar D_d\to I$.
Hence origin-augmented ratio
$R_d=E{\rm Vol}_d/\bar D_d=(2d)^{-d}(d+1)/[1+(d-1)E_d]=3(d+1)2^{-d}/[d^{d-1}(5d-2+3I(d-1)^2)]$, $R_1=1$.
Numerically $R_1=1.000000$, $R_2\approx0.10927$, $R_3\approx0.007513$, $R_4\approx0.000379$, $R_5\approx1.5\times10^{-5}$, $R_d=O((2d)^{-d})$.
$\sum_{d\ge1}R_d=1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots\approx1.1172\approx1.117$ to three decimals, the $d=1$ term being 1 and the remainder $\approx0.117$ essentially the $d=2$ term.

Competing conventions discussed in round 0/1:
* one-point-per-axis distinct normalisation $E{\rm Vol}_d^0=2^{-d}/d!$, $\bar D_d^0=[1+(d-1)I]/(d+1)$ gives $R_d^0=(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}$, $\sum R_d^0\approx1.2497\approx1.25$ and pure inter-point $\sum2^{-d}/(d!I)=(e^{1/2}-1)/I\approx0.848$.
* i.i.d. pair-only normalisation $R_d^\star=(2d)^{-d}/E_d$ gives $R_1^\star=3/4$, $R_2^\star\approx0.0873$, $\sum R_d^\star\approx0.844$.
The problem statement as parsed – $d$ i.i.d. cross points plus origin, mean over all unordered pairs of the $d+1$ set – is the origin-augmented i.i.d. version above, sum $\approx1.117$. No unresolved disagreement on the formulas; only the normalisation convention matters.

1.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The model is the coordinate cross ${\cal C}_{d}= \cup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}$ with i.i.d. points $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$, $K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$, $r_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}[-1,1]$, $E|r|=1/2$.  Put $H_{d}={\rm conv}\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$.  $|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$ on $\{K\;{\rm perm}\}$ with ${\mathbb P}\{K\;{\rm perm}\}=d!/d^{d}$. Hence

$E{\rm Vol}_{d}=d!^{-1}E[\prod|r_{i}|\mathbf1_{{\rm perm}}]=(2d)^{-d}$, $E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2$.

For two i.i.d. cross points $E\|X-Y\|=d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}$ with $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}=\int_{0}^{1}\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}3\approx0.765195716$.

Thus $E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=[2/3+(d-1)I]/d$, $E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2$.

With $N_{d}=d+1$ the mean unordered pair distance in $\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$ is

$\bar D_{d}= \frac{d\,1/2+\binom d2 E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
          =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
          =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\to I$, $\bar D_{1}=1/2$.

Origin-augmented ratio

$R_{d}=E{\rm Vol}_{d}/\bar D_{d}=(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}[5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}]}$,
$R_{1}=1$.

Numerically $R_{1}=1.000000$, $R_{2}\approx0.10927$, $R_{3}\approx0.00751$, $R_{4}\approx0.00038$, $R_{5}\approx1.5\times10^{-5}$, $R_{d}=O((2d)^{-d})$. Hence

$S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}=1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots\approx1.1172\approx1.117$ to three decimals, $d=2$ dominating the remainder.

The current round confirms this i.i.d. cross, origin-augmented, mean-pairwise average convention: all colleagues 1-8 report $R_{1}=1$, $R_{2}\simeq0.109$, sum $\approx1.117$.

Variants noted for bookkeeping: pure inter-point normalisation $R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ gives $R_{1}^{\star}=3/4$, sum $\approx0.844$; one-point-per-axis normalisation $E{\rm Vol}_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$, $\bar D_{d}^{0}=[1+(d-1)I]/(d+1)$ gives $R_{d}^{0}=(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}$, sum $\approx1.2497\approx1.250$ and un-averaged $ \sum 2^{-d}/(d!I)=(e^{1/2}-1)/I\approx0.848$. These are the alternative forms quoted by colleagues, but the literal wording “adding the ensemble to $\{0\}$’’ and average pairwise distance in that $d+1$ set is the $1.117$ value. Unresolved wording ambiguity is which denominator is intended; consensus in round 1 is the origin-augmented mean-pairwise version.

4.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The cross is ${\cal C}_{d}= \bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}$ with i.i.d. sampling $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$, $K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1..d\}$, $r_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}[-1,1]$.  $E|r|=1/2$, $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$,

E V_{d}= \frac1{d!}\Big(E|r|\Big)^{d}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})
       =(2d)^{-d},\qquad EV_{1}=1/2 .
\]

With $N_{d}=d+1$ points the mean unordered pair distance of $S_{d}$ is

\[
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\,E\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I,
\qquad \bar D_{1}=1/2 .
\]

Hence the origin-augmented ratio

\[
R_{d}=\frac{EV_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\big[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\big]},\qquad
R_{1}=1,
\]

$R_{d}=O\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$.  Numerically

\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
d & R_{d}\\ \hline
1 & 1.000000\\
2 & 0.10927\\
3 & 0.00751\\
4 & 3.79\times10^{-4}\\
5 & 1.5\times10^{-5}
\end{array}
\]

The series is therefore essentially $R_{1}+R_{2}$,

\[
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
        =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
        \approx 1.1172,
\]

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$ with the $d=2$ term $0.1093$ dominating
the tail.  This is the $EV_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ i.i.d. cross sum with the
origin added.  In the usual inter-point normalisation
$R_{d}^{\star}=EV_{d}/E_{d}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ the sum is
$\approx0.844$, $\,R_{1}^{\star}=3/4$, and the one-point-per-axis
normalisation $EV_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$ gives
$\sum_{d}R_{d}^{0}\approx1.250$, the familiar $(e^{1/2}-1)/I\approx0.848$
form. ∎

6.text:
The i.i.d. cross model is $X=r e_{K}$, $K\sim{\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$,
$r\sim{\rm Unif}[-1,1]$, $E|r|=1/2$.  Put $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$,
$1\le i\le d$, $H_{d}={\rm conv}\{P_{0},\dots ,P_{d}\}$.

${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation,
${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and on the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.  Hence

$$
E{\rm Vol}_{d}= \frac1{d!}\Big(E|r|\Big)^{d}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})
          =(2d)^{-d},\qquad E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2 ,
$$

and with $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$,

$$
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
  =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
  =\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots
$$

$$
E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
     =d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})I
     =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d},\qquad E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2 .
$$

For the $N_{d}=d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered pair
distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\to I ,
\qquad\bar D_{1}=1/2 .
$$

Hence the origin-augmented ratio

$$
R_{d}= \frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
            {d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]},\qquad R_{1}=1,
$$

is $O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$.  Numerically

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d&R_{d}\\\hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.10927\\
3&0.00751\\
4&3.79\times10^{-4}\\
5&1.5\times10^{-5}
\end{array}
$$

and the series is essentially exhausted after $d=2$.  Thus

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
 =1+0.109270+0.007513+0.000379+\cdots
 \approx1.1172,
$$

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$, the $d=2$ term $0.1093$ dominating the
remainder.  The $d=1$ unit is the origin-augmented i.i.d. cross value;
with the pure inter-point normalisation $R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$
the familiar $\approx0.844$ sum is obtained.

7.text:
For the i.i.d. cross
$X=r e_{K},\;K\sim{\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\},\;r\sim{\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ put
$P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i},1\le i\le d$ and $H_{d}={\rm conv}\{P_{0},P_{1},\dots ,P_{d}\}$.

${\mathbb E}|r|=1/2$ and $ {\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a
permutation, ${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$.  On the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$, so that

${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})
 =\frac1{d!}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})({\mathbb E}|r|)^{d}
 =(2d)^{-d}$, ${\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2$.

For two i.i.d. cross points

${\mathbb E}\|X-Y\|
 =d^{-1}{\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1}){\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}$,
${\mathbb E}|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$,

\[
I:={\mathbb E}\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots ,
\]

hence $E_{d}:={\mathbb E}\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=[2/3+(d-1)I]/d$ and
${\mathbb E}\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2$.
For the $d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered pair distance is

\[
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}}{3d(d+1)}\to I,
\qquad\bar D_{1}=1/2 .
\]

The origin–augmented ratio is

\[
R_{d}=\frac{{\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
            {d^{\,d-1}\bigl[5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\bigr]},\qquad R_{1}=1,
\]

$R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$.  Numerically

$R_{1}=1.000000,\;
R_{2}=0.10927,\;
R_{3}=0.00751,\;
R_{4}=3.79\times10^{-4},\;
R_{5}=1.5\times10^{-5},\dots$

Hence

\[
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
 =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
 \approx1.1172,
\]

i.e. $S_{\infty}\approx1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$, essentially the $d=2$ term $0.1093$.
This is the $ {\mathbb E}{\rm Vol}_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ i.i.d. cross sum with
the origin added.  The familiar inter–point normalisations are
$R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ with $\sum R_{d}^{\star}\approx0.844$
and the one-point-per-axis convention $\sum (d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}
\approx1.250$.

4.text:
On the $d$–cross  

$${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}\{x e_{k}:|x|<1\}, \qquad 
X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}},\;K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1\ldots d\},\;
r_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}[-1,1] $$

i.i.d., put $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$, $1\le i\le d$ and
$H_{d}={\rm conv}\{P_{0},P_{1}\dots P_{d}\}$.

$E|r|=1/2$, $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$$
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
 =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
 =\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots
$$

For $i\ne j$

$$
E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
     =\frac1dE|r_{1}-r_{2}|+\frac{d-1}{d}I
     =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d}=I-\frac{I-2/3}{d},
\qquad E\|X_{i}\|=1/2 .
$$

$V_{d}={\rm Vol}_{d}H_{d}>0$ iff $K_{1}\dots K_{d}$ is a permutation,
${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and on the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$. Hence

$$
E V_{d}= \frac1{d!}\Big(E|r|\Big)^{d}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})
      =(2d)^{-d},\qquad EV_{1}=1/2,
$$

and $V_{d}=0$ otherwise.

For the $N_{d}=d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered pair
distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\,E\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I,
\qquad\bar D_{1}=1/2 .
$$

The origin-augmented volume-to-mean-distance ratio is therefore

$$
R_{d}=\frac{EV_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
            {d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]},\qquad
R_{1}=1,
$$

$R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$. Numerically

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d&R_{d}\\\hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.10927\\
3&0.00751\\
4&0.000379\\
5&1.5\times10^{-5}
\end{array}
$$

so that

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
 =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
 \approx1.1172\approx1.117,
$$

$R_{1}=1$ being the $d=1$ unit contribution and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.1172$, essentially the $d=2$ term
$0.1093$.  This is the i.i.d. cross, origin-inclusive,
$EV_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ series.  On the pure inter-point normalisation
$R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ one obtains $\sum_{d}R_{d}^{\star}
\approx0.844$, and on the usual one-point-per-axis convention
$EV_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$ the origin-augmented sum is
$\sum_{d}(d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}\approx1.250$.

3.text:
For the i.i.d. cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}[-1,1]e_{k}$ ,
$X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$ , $K_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$,
$r_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ i.i.d., $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$,
$H_{d}={\rm conv}\{P_{0},P_{1},\dots ,P_{d}\}$,

$E|r|=1/2$, $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$$
I=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
   =0.765195716\ldots
$$

Put $E_{d}=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|$.  On $K_{i}=K_{j}$ the distance is
$|r_{1}-r_{2}|$ and otherwise $\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}$, whence

$$
E_{d}=d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})I
     =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d}=I+\frac{2/3-I}{d},
\qquad E\|X_{i}\|=1/2 .
$$

${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation,
${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and on the permutation event
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.  Hence

$$
E{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})
   =\frac1{d!}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})(E|r|)^{d}
   =\frac1{d!}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}\Big(\frac12\Big)^{d}
   =(2d)^{-d},\qquad E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2 ,
$$

with the convention $V_{d}=0$ on the collision event.  For the
$N_{d}=d+1$ point set $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered pair distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\,E\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I,
\qquad \bar D_{1}=1/2 .
$$

The origin–augmented ratio is therefore

$$
R_{d}:=\frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]},
\qquad R_{1}=1,
$$
$R_{d}=O\!\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$.  Numerically

$$
\begin{array}{c|c}
d &R_{d}\\ \hline
1&1.000000\\
2&0.10927\\
3&0.00751\\
4&0.000379\\
5&1.5\times10^{-5}
\end{array}
$$

and the series is essentially exhausted after $d=3$.
In particular

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
      =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
      \approx1.1172\;,
$$

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.1172$ with the $d=2$ term $R_{2}\approx0.1093$
dominating the remainder.  This is the $E{\rm Vol}_{d}/\bar D_{d}$
origin–inclusive i.i.d. cross sum.  The familiar point–point
normalisation $R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ gives
$\sum_{d}R_{d}^{\star}\approx0.844$, and with the one-point-per-axis
convention $E{\rm Vol}_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$ the origin-augmented sum is
$\approx1.250$. ∎

8.text:
For the i.i.d. cross

${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}[-1,1]e_{k}$,
$X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$ , $K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1\ldots d\}$,
$r_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ i.i.d., $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$,

$E|r|=1/2$, $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
 =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
 =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
 \approx0.765195716 $ .

For $i\ne j$

$E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
 =d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})I
 =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d}=I-\frac{I-2/3}{d}$,

$E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2$.  $V_{d}>0$ iff $K_{1}\ldots K_{d}$ is a
permutation, $P({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and on the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\ldots X_{d}]|=\prod|r_{i}|$, hence

$E{\rm Vol}_{d}({\rm conv}\{0,X_{1}\ldots X_{d}\})
 =\frac1{d!}\Big(E|r|\Big)^{d}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
 =(2d)^{-d}$,  $E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2$ .

For the $N_{d}=d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the mean unordered pair
distance is

$\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\to I$,

$\bar D_{1}=1/2$.  The origin-augmented mean-volume over mean-pair
ratio is therefore

$R_{d}:=\frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
       =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
       =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
              {d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]}$,
$R_{1}=1$,

$R_{d}=O\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$ summable.  Numerically

$d=1:$ $R_{1}=1.000000$
$d=2:$ $R_{2}= (4)^{-2}/\bar D_{2}\approx0.0625/0.571977\approx0.10927$
$d=3:$ $R_{3}= (6)^{-3}/\bar D_{3}\approx0.0046296/0.616176\approx0.00751$
$d=4:$ $R_{4}\approx3.79\times10^{-4}$
$d=5:$ $R_{5}\approx1.5\times10^{-5}$

and the tail is $<10^{-6}$ for $d\ge6$.  Hence

$S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
 =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
 \approx1.1172$,

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$, essentially the $d=2$ term $0.1093$.
This is the origin-inclusive $E{\rm Vol}_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ series for the
i.i.d. cross model.  In the inter-point only normalisation
$R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ the sum is $\approx0.844$, and with the
one-point-per-axis convention $E{\rm Vol}_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$
$\sum R_{d}^{0}\approx1.250$. ∎

5.text:
With $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$ , $K_{i}\sim {\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$,
$r_{i}\sim U[-1,1]$ i.i.d. and $P_{0}=0$, $P_{i}=X_{i}$,

$E|r|=1/2$, $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and  

$$
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\bigl(1+\sqrt2\bigr)}{3}
   =0.76519575\ldots
$$

For $i\ne j$

$$
E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
      =d^{-1}\frac23+\Bigl(1-d^{-1}\Bigr)I
      =I-\frac{I-2/3}{d},
\qquad E\|X\|=\tfrac12 ,
$$

and on the permutation event ${\mathbb P}\{K_{1}\dots K_{d}{\rm \;perm}\}=
d!/d^{d}$

$$
E V_{d}:=E{\rm Vol}_{d}{\rm conv}\{0,X_{1}\dots X_{d}\}
       =\frac1{d!}\Bigl(\frac12\Bigr)^{d}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}
       =(2d)^{-d},\qquad EV_{1}=1/2 ,
$$

$V_{d}=0$ otherwise.  For the $N_{d}=d+1$ points $\{0,X_{i}\}$ the
mean unordered pair distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{dE\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}}{3d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I ,
$$

$\bar D_{1}=1/2$.  Hence with the origin–augmented normalisation

$$
R_{d}:=\frac{EV_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =\frac{(2d)^{-d}(d+1)}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
            {d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]},\qquad
R_{1}=1,
$$

$R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$ and

* $R_{1}=1.000000$,
* $R_{2}= \displaystyle\frac{3/16}{4/3+I/2}=0.10927\ldots$,
* $R_{3}=0.00751\ldots$,
* $R_{4}=3.79\times10^{-4}\ldots$,
* $R_{5}=1.51\times10^{-5}\ldots$,

so that the series is essentially $R_{1}+R_{2}$.  In closed form

$$
S_{N}=\sum_{d=1}^{N}R_{d}\;,\qquad 
S_{\infty}=1+0.109270+0.007513+0.000379+\cdots\approx1.1172 ,
$$

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$, the $d=2$ term $0.1093$ being the
whole non-trivial remainder.  The $d\ge2$ tail is $R_{2}+R_{3}+\cdots
\approx0.117$, essentially $R_{2}$.

In particular $EV_{d}/\bar D_{d}\to0$ super-exponentially and the
origin-inclusive $E{\rm Vol}_{d}/E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|$ normalisation is
$(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ with sum $\approx0.844$, the one-point-per-axis
normalisation giving $\sum (d+1)2^{-d}/\{d![1+(d-1)I]\}\approx1.250$.
∎

For the $d$-cross
${\cal C}_{d}=\cup_{k=1}^{d}[-1,1]e_{k}$ put 
$X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$,
$K_{i}\sim U\{1,\dots ,d\}$, $r_{i}\sim U[-1,1]$ i.i.d. and
$S_{d}=\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$, $H_{d}={\rm conv}S_{d}$.
$E|r|=1/2$, $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$,

\[
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}du dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log (1+\sqrt2)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots
\]

Put $E_{d}=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|$.  On the same axis 
$\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=|r_{i}-r_{j}|$, on different axes
$\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|=\sqrt{r_{i}^{2}+r_{j}^{2}}$, hence

\[
E_{d}=d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})I
     =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d}=I-\frac{I-2/3}{d},\qquad
E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2 .
\]

$V_{d}>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation,
${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and on the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$.  Hence

\[
E V_{d}= \frac1{d!}\Big(E|r|\Big)^{d}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})
       =(2d)^{-d},\qquad EV_{1}=1/2 .
\]

With $N_{d}=d+1$ points the mean unordered pair distance of $S_{d}$ is

\[
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{d\,E\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I,
\qquad \bar D_{1}=1/2 .
\]

Hence the origin-augmented ratio

\[
R_{d}=\frac{EV_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\big[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\big]},\qquad
R_{1}=1,
\]

$R_{d}=O\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$.  Numerically

\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
d & R_{d}\\ \hline
1 & 1.000000\\
2 & 0.10927\\
3 & 0.00751\\
4 & 3.79\times10^{-4}\\
5 & 1.5\times10^{-5}
\end{array}
\]

The series is therefore essentially $R_{1}+R_{2}$,

\[
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
        =1+0.10927+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots
        \approx 1.1172,
\]

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$ with the $d=2$ term $0.1093$ dominating
the tail.  This is the $EV_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ i.i.d. cross sum with the
origin added.  In the usual inter-point normalisation
$R_{d}^{\star}=EV_{d}/E_{d}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ the sum is
$\approx0.844$, $\,R_{1}^{\star}=3/4$, and the one-point-per-axis
normalisation $EV_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$ gives
$\sum_{d}R_{d}^{0}\approx1.250$, the familiar $(e^{1/2}-1)/I\approx0.848$
form. ∎

$$
E{\rm Vol}_{d}= \frac1{d!}\Big(E|r|\Big)^{d}{\mathbb P}({\rm perm})
          =(2d)^{-d},\qquad E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2 ,
$$

and with $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$,

$$
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
  =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
  =\frac{\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2)}{3}=0.765195716\ldots
$$

$$
E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
     =d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})I
     =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d},\qquad E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2 .
$$

$$

 =\frac{d\frac12+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\to I ,
\qquad\bar D_{1}=1/2 .
$$

$$

     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
            {d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]},\qquad R_{1}=1,
$$

is $O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$.  Numerically

$$

     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}[5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}]}$,

$R_{3}\approx0.00751$,
$R_{4}\approx0.000379$,
$R_{5}\approx1.5\times10^{-5}$,

3.text:
For the $d$ cross ${\cal C}_{d}=\bigcup_{k=1}^{d}[-1,1]e_{k}$ put
$X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$ with $K_{i}\sim{\rm U}\{1,\dots ,d\}$,
$r_{i}\sim{\rm U}[-1,1]$ i.i.d. and $S_{d}=\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$,
$H_{d}={\rm conv}\,S_{d}$.
$E|r|=1/2$, $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$$
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
   =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
   =\frac{\sqrt2+\log \!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}=0.765195\ldots  ,
$$

$$
E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
      =d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})I
      =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d},\qquad E\|X_{i}\|=1/2 .
$$

${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation,
${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and on the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$, so that

$$
E{\rm Vol}_{d}= \frac1{d!}\frac{d!}{d^{d}}\Big(\frac12\Big)^{d}
               =(2d)^{-d},\qquad E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2 .
$$

For the $N_{d}=d+1$ points the mean unordered pair distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{dE\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I,
\qquad\bar D_{1}=1/2 ,
$$

and the origin-augmented volume to mean-distance ratio is

$$
R_{d}=\frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}{d^{\,d-1}\bigl[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\bigr]},\qquad
R_{1}=1,
$$

$R_{d}=O\!\left((2d)^{-d}\right)$.  In particular

* $R_{1}=1.000000$,
* $R_{2}=3\cdot3\cdot2^{-1}2^{-2}/[8+3I]=0.1093\ldots$,
* $R_{3}=0.00751\ldots$,
* $R_{4}=3.79\times10^{-4}\ldots$,
* $R_{5}=1.5\times10^{-5}\ldots$,

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
 =1+0.10929+0.00751+0.00038+\cdots\approx1.1172,
$$

$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.117$, the $d=2$ term $R_{2}\approx0.1093$

public_text.1:
For the i.i.d. cross $X_{i}=r_{i}e_{K_{i}}$,
$K_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}\{1,\dots ,d\}$, $r_{i}\sim{\rm Unif}[-1,1]$ put
$S_{d}=\{0,X_{1},\dots ,X_{d}\}$, $H_{d}={\rm conv}S_{d}$.  

$E|r|=1/2$, $E|r_{1}-r_{2}|=2/3$ and

$$
I:=E\sqrt{r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}}
  =\int_{0}^{1}\!\!\int_{0}^{1}\!\sqrt{u^{2}+v^{2}}\,du\,dv
  =\frac{\sqrt2+\log\!\left(1+\sqrt2\right)}{3}
  =0.765195716464\ldots
$$

For $i\ne j$

$$
E_{d}:=E\|X_{i}-X_{j}\|
     =d^{-1}E|r_{1}-r_{2}|+(1-d^{-1})I
     =\frac{2/3+(d-1)I}{d},
\qquad E\|0-X_{i}\|=1/2 .
$$

${\rm Vol}_{d}(H_{d})>0$ iff $K_{1},\dots ,K_{d}$ is a permutation,
${\mathbb P}({\rm perm})=d!/d^{d}$ and on the permutation
$|\det[X_{1}\dots X_{d}]|=\prod_{i}|r_{i}|$, whence

$$
E{\rm Vol}_{d}
   =\frac1{d!}P({\rm perm})(E|r|)^{d}
   =(2d)^{-d},\qquad E{\rm Vol}_{1}=1/2 ,
$$

$V_{d}=0$ on a collision.  For the $N_{d}=d+1$ points the mean
unordered pair distance is

$$
\bar D_{d}
 =\frac{dE\|X\|+\binom d2E_{d}}{\binom{d+1}{2}}
 =\frac{1+(d-1)E_{d}}{d+1}
 =\frac{(5d-2)/3+(d-1)^{2}I}{d(d+1)}\xrightarrow[d\to\infty]{}I,
\qquad\bar D_{1}=1/2 .
$$

Hence with the origin–augmented normalisation

$$
R_{d}:=\frac{E{\rm Vol}_{d}}{\bar D_{d}}
     =(2d)^{-d}\frac{d+1}{1+(d-1)E_{d}}
     =\frac{3(d+1)2^{-d}}
            {d^{\,d-1}\!\left[\,5d-2+3I(d-1)^{2}\right]},\qquad R_{1}=1,
$$

$R_{d}=O\big((2d)^{-d}\big)$.

Numerically

* $R_{1}=1.000000$,
* $R_{2}=9/\!\left(64+24I\right)=0.109271\ldots$,
* $R_{3}=1.5/\!\left(117+108I\right)=0.007513\ldots$,
* $R_{4}=15/\!\left[1024\,(18+27I)\right]=3.79\times10^{-4}$,
* $R_{5}=1.51\times10^{-5}$,
* $R_{d}\le10^{-6}$ for $d\ge6$.

Hence

$$
S_{\infty}=\sum_{d\ge1}R_{d}
=1+R_{2}+R_{3}+R_{4}+\cdots
=1+0.109271+0.007513+0.000379+\cdots
\approx1.11718,
$$

i.e. $S_{\infty}=1.117$ to three decimals, $R_{1}=1$ and
$\sum_{d\ge2}R_{d}\approx0.1172$ with the $d=2$ term $0.1093$ dominating
the tail.  This is the $E{\rm Vol}_{d}/\bar D_{d}$ i.i.d. cross sum
with the origin added.  The pure inter–point normalisation
$R_{d}^{\star}=(2d)^{-d}/E_{d}$ gives $\sum R_{d}^{\star}\approx0.844$
and the one-point-per-axis convention $E{\rm Vol}_{d}^{0}=2^{-d}/d!$
gives the familiar $\sum R_{d}^{0}\approx1.250$. ∎

 =(\sqrt2+\log(1+\sqrt2))/3\approx0.765195716$.
